scenes.basis: 27:1 "all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus" - continuing 26:57 in the court of Caiaphas; Judas throws the silver in the sanctuary (27:5)
27:11 "Now Jesus stood before the governor" - Pilate at the feast in Jerusalem; 27:19 "sitting on the judgment seat"
27:27 "the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium" - the governor's court in Jerusalem
27:33 "When they came to a place called Golgotha"; Cyrene (27:32) names Simon, not the scene
27:55 "Many women were there watching"; 27:59-60 the burial in the rock tomb at that place (27:33)
27:62 "the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate" - in Jerusalem (27:11)
